name: Progate Group Corporation
summary: Progate Group Corporation engages in the design, development, manufactures, sale, and trading of integrated circuits in Taiwan. It is also involved in intellectual property rights; wholesale of electronic materials and information software; and agency and import and export trade of various related products. The company also offers ASIC design service; ASIC mass production service; IP turnkey service; APR layout turnkey service; gate array turnkey service; foundry turnkey service; cyberShuttle/MPW/prototype service; TSMC CoWoS turnkey service; and TSMC InFO services. Progate Group Corporation was founded in 1980 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan.
